task_name: Mode-II Remeshing Mechanism Diagnostic vs MISESERI Field Investigation
description: Perform remeshing-mechanism-only diagnostic for Mode-II without running fracture simulations or modifying UEL formulation. Determine whether spatial corridor mismatch originates in adaptive-remeshing implementation/configuration or upstream in the MISESERI field. Compare Mode-I and Mode-II remeshing pipelines line-by-line; extract MISESERI from multiple pre-analysis frames (pre-localization, initiation, intermediate, final); test remeshing response to field; quantify local MISESERI vs element sizing h and spatial overlap; classify Case A (remesher follows MISESERI faithfully, fault is upstream) vs Case B (remesher defect); protect Mode-I; produce decision table and 2-panel figure; update governance.
